title: Data items belong to components and ride data flows
description:
As a privacy reviewer, I want a data item to sit on a component and move along a data flow, so that the map says where personal data lives and where it goes.

Feature: data item placement

  Scenario: Data item on a component
    Given a database component
    And a data item for social_security_number
    When I read the graph
    Then the data item belongs to that component

  Scenario: Data item on a flow
    Given a data flow from the app to Checkr
    And a data item for email
    When I read the graph
    Then the flow carries that data item
    And the item is not only a category string
